title: Exploring the Potential of Large Language Models for Improving Digital Forensic Investigation Efficiency

bias_targets.methodology: Literature review and discussion assessing how downstream models inherit social biases from foundation models, referencing external benchmarks like BIG-bench.
Literature review evaluating the performance limitations and reduced effectiveness of LLMs when processing non-English content, due to their predominant training on English data.

Theoretical evaluation of how unrepresentative or biased training data can lead to skewed interpretations and unjust outcomes in digital forensic investigations, alongside a discussion of algorithmic mitigation techniques (e.g., data filtering, rebalancing, and fairness constraints).
